  Location: "Collect validation status" step, line 1492 (`harness_signature_bytes="$(wc -c < "${harness_signature_path}" | tr -d '[:space:]')"`), under `set -euo pipefail` (line 1437)
  Issue: The read is unguarded, unlike the `jq` reads above, which carry `|| true` / `|| echo none`. A failed read aborts the whole `collect_status` step under `set -e`.
  Suggested minimal fix: `harness_signature_bytes="$(wc -c < "${harness_signature_path}" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]' || true)"`, keeping the `^[0-9]+$` test.
  Estimated lines changed: 1
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- File: .github/workflows/validate.yml
  Location: "Report the harness-owned validation failure to workflow failure heal" step, line 1958 (`mkdir -p "${report_dir}"`)
  Issue: The job comment says "The reporter always exits 0", but a failed `mkdir` aborts the step under `set -euo pipefail` and turns heal-report red.
  Suggested minimal fix: `mkdir -p "${report_dir}" || { echo "::warning::WORKFLOW_HEAL_PHASE_REPORT skip reason=report_dir_unavailable"; exit 0; }`
  Estimated lines changed: 2
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
